output.title: Remote access tool execution from user-writable paths (helpdesk impersonation)
output.query:
let RATs = dynamic(["AnyDesk","TeamViewer","ScreenConnect","ConnectWiseControl","SplashtopStreamer","Splashtop","LogMeIn","RustDesk","Atera","AteraAgent","NinjaRMM","ngrok","Pulseway","Level","Action1","ZohoAssist","Zoho","UltraViewer","BeyondTrust","Bomgar","DWAgent","MeshAgent","quickassist"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "ProcessCreated"
| where ProcessVersionInfoProductName has_any (RATs) or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName has_any (RATs) or FileName has_any (RATs)
| where FolderPath has_any ("\\Users\\", "\\Downloads\\", "\\AppData\\", "\\Temp\\") or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","outlook.exe","teams.exe","msteams.exe")
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Executions=count() by DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
| order by FirstSeen desc
expected_false_positives: Legitimate IT helpdesk sessions using approved remote support tools
Users installing sanctioned RMM or remote access software
Software deployment tools launching remote access agents
output.tuning_notes: Exclude remote access tools approved by IT (by SHA256, signer or device group). Prioritise tools not in your software inventory, first-seen executions per device, and hits followed by new outbound connections to the tool's relay infrastructure. Correlate with helpdesk ticket and call records.
assumptions: Defender for Endpoint populates DeviceProcessEvents with ProcessVersionInfo fields
The report's quote gives only the technique ID; behaviour is drawn from surrounding context describing employees directed to run commercial remote access tools
No approved-tool allowlist is applied, so legitimate tools will match

confidence.rationale: Behavioural hunt on common dual-use remote tools; the user-writable-path filter helps, but legitimate IT use is frequent.
